svg.title: The next constraint may sit beyond the operating room.

cc:Work.dc:title: The next constraint may sit beyond the operating room.
cc:Work.dc:description: Synthetic cases · two operating rooms held fixed · recovery capacity changes from one to two · 15-minute model slots Source: recorded SciPy/HiGHS fixture. Procedure bars and hatched turnover reserve OR capacity; recovery occupies its own time interval. Surgeon and instrument constraints also apply. No patient urgency, clinical staffing standard, stochastic-duration model, or live hospital feed.
